title: Introduce geo-fence claim bridge and KMS provenance gateway
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: customers operating across regulated regions asked for stronger guarantees that KMS usage and audit records are tied to tenant residency assertions issued at the edge. This PR implements a lightweight translation bridge that normalizes incoming residency claims into an internal ClaimEnvelope format, a KMS Provider Selector that pins KMS calls to a vetted provider set based on the translated claims, and an Audit Provenance Gateway that signs and watermarks audit events to prevent cross-region replay and to improve forensic traceability. Changes are scoped to the API gateway, kms client layer, and audit pipeline only; no runtime model-serving hot path changes. Scope: 1) claim-bridge: new component that canonicalizes multiple claim formats (JWT residency, x-Region headers, proxy assertions) into ClaimEnvelope with origin, confidence, and ttl metadata; 2) kms-proxy: provider selector uses ClaimEnvelope to enforce tenant-bound provider allowlists and emits provider_usage metrics; 3) audit-gateway: attaches provenance-hash and watermark fields, supports ensembled-signatures for multi-provider key attestations, and exposes an audit-proofing endpoint for downstream compliance processors. Rollout plan: feature-flag gated behind security.geo_claim_bridge and audit.provenance_gate, staged canary in eu-west-1 then us-east-1, 72h monitoring window. Backwards compatibility: bridge accepts previous claim formats and falls back to operator-labeled provider selection when claims are absent. Testing: unit tests for claim translation matrix, integration smoke for kms-selection, end-to-end staging run with synthetic tenant flows. Related: ENG-2019 design doc (internal), SEC-118 incident follow-up. Checklist: ensure feature flags exist, update operator docs, validate KMS allowlists in customer configs, coordinate with on-call for rollout window.

testing_notes: Unit: claim translation matrix covers 12 permutations of claim formats. Integration: provider selector exercised with three simulated tenants across eu-west-1/us-east-1. Staging e2e: synthetic tenant flow validated provenance_hash replay protection by attempting to re-ingest staged audit events; gateway rejected duplicates as expected.
rollout_notes: Gate behind security.geo_claim_bridge and audit.provenance_gate. Canary in eu-west-1 for 24h, expand to us-east-1 for 48h with continuous health checks: error rates, kms_provider_mismatch, audit_replay_count, latency_p95. If audit_replay_count increases >0.1% rollback immediately and alert SEC and SRE on-call.

release_notes: Added geo-claim translation bridge and audit provenance gateway to improve region-bound KMS provider selection and prevent cross-region audit replay. Not a breaking change; feature gated and disabled by default.
